# A pad triggers the wrong sound

also: the wrong drum fires

## The pad's note does not match the Drum Rack pad's receive note
check: the Drum Rack pad names a note the controller does not send
fix: ableton/live-12 §24.6

## The mapping was made to the wrong note
check: Key/MIDI Map Mode shows the pad mapped elsewhere
fix: ableton/live-12 §33.2.2
